title: Study: ‘Classic example’ of sexual dimorphism in fossil record actually shows nuance between males and females
summary_en: A new study from the University of Kansas appearing in the open-access, peer-reviewed journal PLOS One shows the differences between male and female uintatheres might not be as vast as paleontologists have long believed.
title_cn: Study: ‘Classic example’ of sexual dimorphism in fossil record actually shows nuance between males and females

title: Spencer Museum’s Backyard Bash returns Oct. 11 to celebrate art and nature in Marvin Grove
summary_en: The Spencer Museum of Art Backyard Bash, an outdoor and indoor celebration of art and nature, returns from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. Oct. 11. The free, all-ages community event will take place at the museum as well as in KU’s historic Marvin Grove.
title_cn: Spencer Museum’s Backyard Bash returns Oct. 11 to celebrate art and nature in Marvin Grove

title: KU Distinguished Professor will explore how deep-space signals reach Earth
summary_en: Erik Perrins will deliver his inaugural distinguished professor lecture, “Finding the Signal in the Noise: The Hidden Magic of Error Correcting Codes in Deep-Space Radios,” on Nov. 11.
title_cn: KU Distinguished Professor will explore how deep-space signals reach Earth
